canonical_lineage.source: authenticated canonical state: the current descriptor of treasury_authority after the canonical application of rotation_plan

rotation_plan.source: rotation_plan: authority = treasury_authority, current = K1 descriptor, proposed = K2 descriptor; authorization by K1 under MUTINY-BUILD8-WALLET-KEY-ROTATE-V1 and possession by K2 under MUTINY-BUILD8-WALLET-KEY-ROTATE-POSSESSION-V1, both over unsigned_body_hex; genesis and fingerprint equal to the trusted chain identity below

K1.role: Treasury generation-one key (the trusted Treasury record carries its descriptor)

K2.role: authorized successor: proposed descriptor of the rotation plan, generation 2

K3.role: impostor: an unrelated generation-2 key that signs the Treasury's public identifiers

note: Public data only. Keys derive from public labels (TEST-VALUE). FN-DSA signatures are randomized, so the signatures are fixed by this file and verification is the check; every other field is a pure function of the labels. 'crypto' is the verdict of the strict challenge decoder plus both signatures over the proof's own descriptor (Challenge::verify); 'ceremony' is the verdict against the TRUSTED expectation. P5 carries a hybrid signature made through the raw signing API by a TEST-VALUE key solely as a negative control: its phase byte is 2 and it must be refused.
